question: What was the average number of vehicles in force across the four quarter-ends of 2025?
final_text:
The average number of vehicles in force across the four 2025 quarter-ends was 37,551.

I counted a vehicle as in force at a date if its policy term had started on or before that date and expired after it. I also excluded any term cancelled on or before that date. Each in-force term is one vehicle, and no policy had more than one term in force at any of the dates.

| Quarter-end | Vehicles in force |
|---|---|
| 31 Mar 2025 | 35,517 |
| 30 Jun 2025 | 36,701 |
| 30 Sep 2025 | 38,079 |
| 31 Dec 2025 | 39,907 |

The four counts total 150,204, and dividing by 4 gives 37,551.

ANSWER: 37551

input.query:
with d(d) as (values (date '2025-03-31'),(date '2025-06-30'),(date '2025-09-30'),(date '2025-12-31'))
select d, count(*) n, count(distinct policy_id) p from d join policy_term t on t.inception_date<=d and t.expiry_date>d and (t.cancel_date is null or t.cancel_date>d) group by d order by d
